purpose: Historical measured evidence for 3D representation research; geometry and performance observations, not a demonstrated optical-position accuracy comparison.

units.file_size: bytes unless explicitly noted; decimal MB=1000000 bytes

binary_full.coordinates: original voxel centres, one zero ghost sample per face
binary_full.source_fraction_rule: ff=129 is single material; otherwise fraction1=ff/128
binary_full.binarization_rule: dominant material: ff>=64 chooses mat1; ff<64 chooses mat2; single material preserved
limitations: Mixed-cell fractional geometry is lost during binarization.
Lumerical interpolates binary samples; the boundary is not a union of exact voxel cubes.
Crop sides are artificial closures; not a complete mark or physical lateral boundary.
No optical source, spectrum, or time-domain solution is included in the geometry import.

small_crop_comparison.scope: Identical x=22.6..25.4 um, y=-1..1 um, z=-0.5..0.5 um crop; 46 native ray sidewall reference points at a single y=0.01 um section.
small_crop_comparison.binary_error_caveat: binary_interpolated is our interpolated source 0/1 field contour, NOT a directly measured Lumerical boundary.

fraction_surface.method: Lewiner marching cubes, original Si fraction field, isolevel0.5

native_ray_comparison.reference: native GetRayIntersection top; comparison is not physical calibration

fraction_surface.limitation: FF alone does not determine the unique native material interface.

plane_surface.method: Plane-assisted center scalar field; zero-level Lewiner marching cubes; small-crop prototype
limitations: The coordinate frame was checked only using saved rays in this specific crop; it is not a general or official plane-format guarantee.
The field samples local planes at voxel centers and interpolates between those samples. It is not an exact clipping or union of native interface planes.
The constructed field is not guaranteed to be a globally consistent signed distance function.
Pure-material signs are corrected from Si/Air labels; mixed-material plane signs are preserved.
The one-layer exterior pad creates artificial closures at crop boundaries.
Plane, fraction and native ray data can disagree slightly; no physical accuracy or lossless recovery is claimed.
Closed shared edges and positive signed volume do not prove absence of self-intersections.
FDTD import and independent boundary/CD comparison remain to be performed.
plane_surface.final_status_correction: Creation-time report said import pending; later comparison.json and plane_surface/import_report.json confirm import, save/reopen and boundary comparison completed. No time-domain solve.

notes: FindZElevationAtPoint and downward ray intersection are separate native measurements.
A single top height cannot represent reentrant interfaces or overhangs.
Simple mesh geometryAccuracy=100 is the highest setting, not a documented lossless export.

height_queries.native_ray_returns: ((x,y,z),(nx,ny,nz),material_id); air/no hit can return mat=255 and invalid point; rays begun inside material are not used to enumerate all exits.
height_queries.column_uniqueness: Top is one outermost hit by definition; this does not demonstrate a column has only one material interface.

crop_reentrant_binary_check.interpretation: Such columns cannot be represented exactly by one solid-below-height map at this threshold. Absence alone would not exclude sub-voxel overhang.

delaunay20nm_export.reason: Missing COV_DelaunayMesh license feature; license paths and server details omitted.

native_full_accuracy.reference: Native GetRayIntersection on original saved step7 wafer
native_full_accuracy.limitation: Sampled sidewall positions only; not a certified bound on every triangle, LER spectrum or optical error

audit.limit: Closure and volume checks do not certify every surface point or optical accuracy.

limitations: Native surface export is approximate, not a lossless representation.
Missing PlaneEquations cannot be uniquely recovered from material fractions.
Dopant/metrology fields are not converted into optical constitutive models.

reference_comparison.limitation: A fraction-only VDATA cannot uniquely specify its original within-cell interface; this comparison includes missing-information and meshing errors.

lossless.limitation: Indexed NPZ preserves geometry exactly but is a converter interchange, not a native FDTD import format. Gzip needs decompression before opening; neither changes the solver mesh or reduces CAD object count.

planar.predicate: exact integer orient3d on source float32 dyadic coordinates
planar.boundary_handling: Collinear boundary vertices retained exactly to prevent T junctions; non-simple boundaries fall back to source triangles.
planar.geometry_scope: Same surface as the existing STL, not a correction of STL approximation to source VDATA.
planar.limitation: Mathematical surface equivalence of strict coplanar unions; downstream importer triangulation and optical mesh still require validation.

audit.note: Fan triangles are used only for exact signed-volume integration; concave polygons and holes must be imported as rings, not this fan.

conclusions: Indexed shared-vertex addplanarsolid and stlimport save the same geometric payload: FSP size differs by only 17 bytes. stlimport already merges repeated vertices.
Exactly coplanar polygon merging reduced FSP by only 2.35% here and did not reduce measured import-stage CAD private commit.
Retrieving heterogeneous polygon facets returns a globally padded matrix in this installation: 256 x 2 x 168281 doubles, 689278976 bytes. CAD query temporary peak reached 2.38 GB.
QEM candidates reduce FSP and observed private CAD memory; geometry approximation errors must be read from the independent surface and sidewall reports.
Each memory test used a new hidden CAD session. Values include allocators, caches, CAD rendering and import/load temporary buffers. They are not pure geometry bytes.
There is no FDTD region or time-domain solve in these geometry projects. These measurements do not establish solver memory savings.
Triangle hashes canonicalize the undirected triangle point set after float32 um quantization; save/reopen also separately checked complete facet-array equality.

one_ps_prediction.assumption: Same mesh, materials, sources and monitors; no early auto shutoff. Extrapolation is a runtime estimate, not a completed 1 ps solve or an optical convergence result.

interpretation_limits: 40 nm 均匀网格在 Si 中约 3.2 点/波长，仅适合粗性能测试，不代表物理精度已足够。
100 fs 试跑禁用自动终止用于测量性能；完成不代表场充分衰减，不是网格或时长收敛。
正式配置 1 ps 是最大物理时长，auto shutoff 1e-5 可能提前结束；物理时长与墙钟时间不同。
Gaussian 时间脉冲中心为 532 nm、脉宽 20 fs，并非严格连续单频光源；DFT 仅记录 532 nm。
共形网格 checker 可能低估实际内存。推荐内存是各阶段峰值，不把运行、初始化、收集要求相加。
表面局部网格需要过渡与材料自动细化，远场网格并非可以任意粗化；只有性能试跑档位实际分配网格并运行，其余档位仍是检查器估计。
T 位于 Si 内，表示该截面剩余通量，不是晶圆背面透射率。
内存可容纳与运行时间可接受，都不能替代光学网格、PML、时长收敛验证。
